title: Crimp Force Curve Dataset
version: Harvard Dataverse versions 1.0, 2.0 and 3.0. Zenodo record 15421197 carries the Harvard DOI; its one pickle has the same size and published MD5 as Harvard v2, not v3.
rights: Harvard Dataverse CC0 1.0 for all three dataset releases. Zenodo record specifies CC BY 4.0; attribute Hofmann, Bründl and Franke. Companion paper and software have separate terms. Only derived aggregate statistics, source references and independent reader shared.

associated_article.locator: Methods, Data Records and Technical Validation, including manufactured defects, encoded outputs and sensor placement.

measured: Eccentric press connecting-rod strain sensor sampled over press angle. Each trace uses uncalibrated force sensor counts in 3,566 positions. No independent contact switch, actual conductor sliding displacement, pull-out force, continuity measurement, or per-row physical force unit provided.
labels: Use fixed preparation label (OK, one/two/three missing strands, crimped insulation) as a separate process input, and compare with the force-based inline monitor label. Correct preparation does not independently prove electrical contact/retention performance. In version 3, 200 of 811 prepared NOK crimps pass the monitor: 123/172 of the one-missing-strand cases. All 1,628 prepared OK cases pass. Counts conditional on prepared specimens, operator and process; not a population prevalence.
version_audit: v1 contains 2,440 unique IDs; v2 drops ID 20603. All other raw waves and annotations remain identical. v2/v3 share 2,439 IDs and raw waves (8,697,474 raw values). Baseline and 500-point ROI change for 2,270 IDs only by a constant offset inside each wave (v2 minus v3, −10 to +3 counts). Only v3 reconstructs baseline as raw[0]−raw for all rows; in v2 this holds for 169. The ROI is baseline[1575:2075] in each version.
reproduce: Save the three Harvard downloads under files[].local_name (or use the matching Zenodo v2 mirror); python derive_crimp.py INPUT_DIR OUT. Tested with pandas 2.2 and NumPy. Exact pinned file checksum required before pickle loading.
